data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'heos' meaning 'god' and 'linos' meaning 'man'. In the New Testament, the name Weylin is associated with the early Christian martyrs who dedicated their lives to serving God. The name Weylin carries the meaning “Man of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Weylin usually hope their child will grow to embody man of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Weylin total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
